Specification: This specification is a small test module that checks use of EXTENDS with a user-defined module and TLC. It models a one-variable system where the initial condition is given by the imported operator MInit applied to x, and the next-state action sets x' equal to c. It also defines an invariant-style state predicate Inv that uses an IF expression and TLC's Print operator to report whether the current value of x equals c.
IfThenElse: IF (x=c) THEN Print("Test OK", TRUE) ELSE Print("Test Failed", TRUE)
